decision_scope: screening recommendation for a controlled pilot; not a rollout instruction
decision_rationale: Blocking diagnostics require a better controlled experiment.

warnings.message: The estimate is an observational audit and does not identify a treatment effect.
Unit margin is unavailable, so profit is not calculated.
The source has no inventory field, so stockout-censored demand cannot be diagnosed.
Post-promotion demand is more than 20% below the pre-promotion average.

assumptions: The last observed non-promotion units are a usable short-horizon baseline.
The 90th percentile of pre-event one-week residuals is a useful audit interval.
No unobserved distribution or assortment change invalidates the comparison.
claim_language: observational incremental-units estimate; causal effect not identified
